test_penalties fails two repeat_trap cases at seed 1234 / temperature 0.1 although every penalty changes the output: repetition_penalty=1.5 raises the unique-word ratio 0.21 -> 0.42 (the 446-word robotic story becomes 666 words of prose) but the rule compares the ABSOLUTE most-common-word count (56 -> 79), which grows with length; presence_penalty=1.2 yields a different repetitive story (the prompt asks for one) whose ratio drops 0.211 -> 0.186, past the 90%-of-baseline rule. Identical numbers on two tt-shield runs (37495434533, 37560947407); the other 7 cases pass. Same exemption as Llama-3.3-70B P300X2 (#3888). Measured 2026-10-07.

test_penalties[repetition_penalty-1.5-natural_repetition] fails the "increase diversity" rule at seed 1234 / temperature 0.1: the penalty changes the bananas paragraph but its unique-word ratio moves 0.757 -> 0.741, inside per-seed noise. Identical on tt-shield run 37518281683 and on a local run of the same stack (2026-10-06); the other 8 cases pass and the P300X2 entry passes all 9. Same exemption as Llama-3.3-70B P300X2 (#3888).

test_penalties[presence_penalty-1.2-repeat_trap] ('reduced diversity', seed 1234) is per-seed noise in the test's 90%-of-baseline rule, not a device fault: over 8 seeds of the same request (temperature 0.1, 'Write a very repetitive story.'), presence_penalty=1.2 raises the mean unique-word ratio on device 0.165 -> 0.245 and under vLLM's host sampler (logprobs forces it) 0.160 -> 0.286, and the rule would fail 1/8 seeds on device and 2/8 under the host reference. Measured 2026-10-03 on QB2, image qz-current-main-3f42cb95; every other spec case passes.

test_penalties[presence_penalty-1.2-natural_repetition] is a legitimate no-op: at temperature 0.1 / seed 1234 the baseline and presence_penalty=1.2 outputs are byte-identical while frequency_penalty=1.2 diverges only where the baseline emits '.', a token already used 5 times (frequency subtracts 1.2*5, presence 1.2 once). Presence does change Qwen3-4B output on repeat_trap and semantic_repetition, so the device presence mask updates. Same exemption TTIS states for Llama-3.3-70B (#3888). Measured 2026-10-02 on QB2, image qz-current-main-3f42cb95; 21/22 spec cases pass.

The checkpoint's chat template always opens a thinking turn (add_generation_prompt emits '<ifm|think>' for the default reasoning_effort high; there is no thinking-off switch) and the row ships no reasoning parser (the k2_horizon parser is not in this runtime), so message.content starts with the model's own reasoning ('The user asks to repeat a sentence exactly, no extra words, no quotes, no commentary. So we must output exactly: The quick brown fox jumps over the') and the test's 32-token budget runs out inside it (finish_reason=length at 32). Judged by a rule fixed before the data (p01t07 state/k2echo/k2-echo-rule-20261017.txt, sha256 b43af275, criteria verbatim from 1fd9ed5a, coordinator OK 2026-10-17): on the exact payload with seeds 1..16 the device sampler and vLLM's host sampler (forced with logprobs) return the identical text, 16/16 each (miss rates 1.0 vs 1.0, test holds); all 48 outputs are coherent (non-empty, printable, no 8-gram repeated 3x in a row, on-task); with the budget raised to 512 tokens the device closes the reasoning and answers, 16/16 finish=stop at 121 tokens ending '</ifm|think>The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.'. Measured 2026-10-17 on QB2 (exabox p01t07) with image sha256:26cdfb7c, package adabbeea (manifest 9323af72), TTIS 2739c31f; every other spec case passes, test_non_uniform_seeding included.

The test sends 32 concurrent 50-token requests through api_client's default 30 s read timeout (test_fixtures/conftest.py:136). On Qwen3-32B at 4-chip decode that budget is a latency bound, not a seeding check: with the stock 30 s timeout the case fails 'Read timed out. (read timeout=30)' and 21/22 spec cases pass; the same package and TTIS ref with only that request's timeout raised to 600 s passes the case and Acceptance is PASS (0 blockers), so per-request seeding is honoured. Measured 2026-10-05 on QB2 (exabox p01t01), image vllm-tt-metal-src-dev@sha256:40c92b7d, package manifest e4d9e948.

QwQ-32B is a reasoning model served with the deepseek_r1 reasoning parser (upstream's parser for this checkpoint). With the test's 32-token budget at temperature 0 it spends the whole budget inside the reasoning channel, so message.content is None (finish_reason=length) while reasoning_content is a coherent restatement of the instruction ('Okay, the user wants me to repeat the exact sentence they provided...'). Measured 8/8 identical on device, 2026-10-12 on QB2 with image sha256:ea7a4346, package manifest 0d5ccfb8, TTIS 9afaa3f2. Same reasoning-channel budget class as gpt-oss-120b (#200).

With the reasoning parser enabled, the requested stop string 'Stop' fires inside the reasoning channel when the model quotes the prompt's 'StopIt' ('Okay, the user wants me to count to 5 and then say ...'), so finish_reason=stop at 16 tokens and message.content is None. The stop parameter is honoured; there is no final content to check. Measured 8/8 identical on device, 2026-10-12 on QB2 with image sha256:ea7a4346, package manifest 0d5ccfb8, TTIS 9afaa3f2; the alternate stop case passes.

The test sends 32 concurrent 50-token requests and checks seeding on message.content. QwQ-32B spends all 50 tokens in the reasoning channel (32/32 finish_reason=length at completion_tokens == 50, content None), and the 32-way concurrent decode takes ~45 s per request, past the test's 30 s read timeout. With the timeout raised to 600 s the case still fails only on content None (test line 189). The seeding property the test checks holds on reasoning_content: seed-0 requests give 1 distinct output (test requires == 1) and seeded requests give 16/16 distinct (test requires >= max(2, int(16*0.6)) = 9); all 32 reasoning texts are coherent. Measured 2026-10-12 on QB2 with image sha256:ea7a4346, package manifest 0d5ccfb8, TTIS 9afaa3f2. Reasoning-channel budget class as gpt-oss-120b (#200).

At repetition_penalty=1.5 the checkpoint occasionally degenerates into a 1024-token run-on word list inside the reasoning channel (finish_reason=length, message.content None), which crashes the test's .lower(). This is model behaviour, not a device sampler fault: over 9 seeds the device sampler and vLLM's host sampler (forced with logprobs) show the same direction (unique-word ratio device 0.595 -> 0.868, host 0.637 -> 0.868) and the same 1/9 degenerate rate (device seed 1234, host seed 8). Measured 2026-10-12 on QB2 with image sha256:ea7a4346, package manifest 0d5ccfb8, TTIS 9afaa3f2; every other penalties case passes.

'Penalty unexpectedly reduced diversity' (unique-word ratio 0.0188 vs floor 0.9 x 0.186 = 0.167) is the checkpoint's own penalized output, not the device path: HF transformers bf16 on CPU, greedy, with presence_penalty=1.2 over output tokens reproduces the device's penalized completion at 1024/1024 positions (teacher-forced argmax agreement, min margin 0.075) and generates the same 1024-token loop at ratio 0.0188, while its unpenalized run reproduces the device baseline. At the loop restart the top logit 'Once' is 18.75 and the best unused token 'Lily' 15.69, so a 1.2 presence penalty (17.55) cannot break the loop. Penalty state resets per request (tt_penalties.py:38-42, generator.py:195-215, serving/ttnn_sampling_block.py:185-187); only a stale mask would raise the ratio (0.598). Falcon3-1B/10B-Instruct share the tokenizer and vocab and pass this case. Measured 2026-10-07 on QB2 (exabox p01t01), image vllm-tt-metal-src-dev@sha256:a557ba97, package manifest db5e2a62; 21/22 spec cases pass.

DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B is a reasoning model: with the test's max_tokens 32 at temperature 0 it spends the budget reasoning before answering. The measured output is coherent and on-task ('Okay, so I need to figure out how to respond to this query. The user is asking me to repeat a specific sentence exactly, without any extra words,'), not the corrupted-forward-pass gibberish the guard targets, but the generic test requires the full sentence inside those 32 tokens. Same exemption as openai/gpt-oss-120b above; test_coherence_verbatim_echo is not parametrized, so this names one case. Measured 2026-10-07 on QB2 (exabox p01t01), image vllm-tt-metal-src-dev@sha256:a557ba97, package f3fca23b; the other 21/22 spec cases pass.

The base checkpoint's chat template opens a thinking turn and upstream declares no reasoning parser for it (none is configured), so message.content starts with the model's own reasoning ('First, the user said: "Repeat the following sentence exactly, ... The quick brown fox jumps over the') and the test's 32-token budget runs out inside it (finish_reason=length at 32). Judged by a rule fixed before the data (p01t07 state/q35-9b-base-echo-rule-20261016.txt, sha256 1fd9ed5a, 2026-10-16T17:35:26Z): on the exact payload with seeds 1..16 the device sampler and vLLM's host sampler (forced with logprobs) return the identical text, 16/16 each (miss rates 1.0 vs 1.0, test holds); all 48 outputs are coherent (non-empty, printable, no 8-gram repeated 3x in a row, on-task); with the budget raised to 512 tokens the device closes the reasoning and answers, 16/16 finish=stop at 209 tokens ending '</think>\n\nThe quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.'. Measured 2026-10-16 on QB2 (exabox p03t06) with image sha256:9aef02d1, package 3acdbdf4 (manifest dd1673f1), TTIS a49017f6; every other spec case passes, test_non_uniform_seeding included.

The checkpoint's chat template is a channel protocol (reasoning on '<|start|>assistant to=self<|message|>', answer on 'to=user'); upstream declares no reasoning parser for it and none is configured, so message.content carries the model's reasoning preamble (' to=selfWrite a very repetitive story. We need to write a very repetitive story. Probably comply...') ahead of the story. The GPU reference run (H100, vLLM 0.28.0, no --reasoning-parser) produces the same content format, so the row matches it like-for-like. The test's whitespace word counts therefore include that preamble. At the test's seed 1234 the penalty is applied (unique-word ratio 0.241 -> 0.322, text shorter 985 -> 645 tokens) but the top word count moves 56 -> 63, failing the 'top count does not grow' assertion; over seeds 1..8 that assertion holds 8/8 and the unique-ratio assertion holds 9/9 (mean top count over 9 seeds 92.8 -> 57.2, mean unique ratio 0.213 -> 0.416), all outputs coherent and finish=stop. Measured 2026-10-11 on QB2 with image sha256:72f111b4, package manifest bf5c00a5, TTIS b45fed11; every other spec case passes.

presence_penalty=1.2 on this checkpoint makes the 'Write a very repetitive story' completion much LONGER, and a longer whitespace-split text has a lower unique-word ratio, so the test's 'penalty must not reduce diversity below 90% of base' rule fails. That is the checkpoint's own behaviour, not a device sampler fault: on the same package and server, vLLM's host sampler (forced with logprobs) shows the same direction and a larger effect over 9 seeds (unique ratio 0.556 -> 0.374, mean length 195 -> 454 words), while the device sampler gives 0.551 -> 0.443 at ~1.7x length; the penalty changes the text on 9/9 seeds, every completion is coherent and finish=stop. Measured 2026-10-12 on QB2 with image sha256:44dc0aef, package manifest ebd87982, TTIS c3525826; every other spec case passes (spec 2026-10-10 8/9 penalties).

Asked to repeat 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.' exactly, the checkpoint returns the sentence without the final period and ends the turn: 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog', finish_reason=stop at 10 tokens, the last token id 2 = EOS directly after 'dog'. The test requires the period-terminated substring. This is the checkpoint's own output, not a device fault: at temperature 0 the device sampler and vLLM's host sampler (forced with logprobs) return the identical text, finish_reason and token count on 6/6 runs. Measured 2026-10-13 on QB2 with image sha256:7084d139, package manifest a5e1a4c4, TTIS 6345af7b; every other spec case passes.

At seed 1234 the penalized reply ('Write a paragraph about bananas using simple language.', temperature 0.1) is longer than the baseline (the checkpoint writes its reasoning into content), so its unique-word ratio falls 0.536 -> 0.459 and the test's diversity assertion fails. This is seed variance of the checkpoint under presence_penalty, not a device-sampler fault, judged by a rule fixed before the data (2026-10-13T04:20:00Z): on 32 fresh seeds (101..132) the device sampler fails the assertion on 3/32 and vLLM's host sampler (forced with logprobs) on 7/32, not significantly different (|diff| 0.125 <= pooled two-proportion 95% bound 0.178); the mean penalized-minus-base unique-ratio change is +0.0129 (sd 0.0607) on device vs +0.0082 (sd 0.0679) on host, within 2 combined standard errors (0.0047 <= 0.0322); all 128 outputs are coherent (non-empty, finish stop/length, on topic, no 8-gram repeated 3x in a row). Measured 2026-10-13 on QB2 with image sha256:7084d139, package 6d01c3de, TTIS b993e299; every other spec case passes.
